summary: W. P. Carey Inc. filed an 8-K to report the completion of a $350M public offering of 5.200% Senior Notes due 2036, issued under a shelf registration. The notes were priced at par and settled July 2, 2026, with semi-annual interest and a make-whole redemption clause. Proceeds will refinance $350M of 4.250% notes due October 2026 and for general corporate purposes. This is a routine debt refinancing, not a special situation.
